expectations.name: initial_trip
expectations.detail: triggering event (fault_fired {'slot': 'weld_ssr'}) never occurred [BLOCKED: RESOLVED on the SaftyFW side, still blocked on the fixture. The previous reason here -- 'context_valid is never set true by safety_core_build_input()' -- was fixed by commit f304392: context_valid, any_current_present and relay_commanded_recently are all populated for real now (virtual_dut measures context_valid true on every poll of this scenario), so S3 is EVALUATED every tick instead of being force-reset. What it never sees is current: firmware/SimFW/src/tasks/sim_engine.c gates heater duty and CT current on K4, K4 never closes (no scenario issues the operator SAFETY_CMD_REQUEST_ENABLE -- see the K4 blocked_on entries elsewhere in this library), so any_current_present is false for the whole run (measured 0 of ~83 polls), and S3's `any_current_present && !relay_commanded_recently` condition can never be true.]

blocked_on.reason: RESOLVED on the SaftyFW side, still blocked on the fixture. The previous reason here -- 'context_valid is never set true by safety_core_build_input()' -- was fixed by commit f304392: context_valid, any_current_present and relay_commanded_recently are all populated for real now (virtual_dut measures context_valid true on every poll of this scenario), so S3 is EVALUATED every tick instead of being force-reset. What it never sees is current: firmware/SimFW/src/tasks/sim_engine.c gates heater duty and CT current on K4, K4 never closes (no scenario issues the operator SAFETY_CMD_REQUEST_ENABLE -- see the K4 blocked_on entries elsewhere in this library), so any_current_present is false for the whole run (measured 0 of ~83 polls), and S3's `any_current_present && !relay_commanded_recently` condition can never be true.
blocked_on.phase: Not a SaftyFW phase gap any more -- safety_core_build_input() reads link_task's published context via link_task_get_context_snapshot() and reduces it with the pure context_reduce_zones()/current_any_present() helpers in src/snapshots.h. The remaining gap is SimFW-side and circular: no current flows because K4 is open, and K4 is open because no scenario performs the operator enable. Breaking it needs a scenario that issues ENABLE (dut_core.exe supports it) or a fault that forces CT current independently of duty, e.g. welded_k4_current_persist, which bypasses the duty path entirely.
